diagrams.title: **One microVM per session
diagrams.caption: **One microVM per session.** A microVM is a tiny virtual machine that starts in a fraction of a second but has the hard isolation of a full VM.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 340" aria-label="Runtime session isolation. Session 1 runs inside microVM 1 with its own kernel; session 2 runs inside microVM 2 with its own kernel. Each session has its own memory, files and connections; nothing is shared between them. When a session ends its microVM is destroyed and its memory sanitised." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <rect x="20" y="20" width="520" height="300" rx="24" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:3"></rect>
      <text x="44" y="56" class="tl ink-proto" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#4B2B97;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">AgentCore Runtime</text>
      <rect x="50" y="80" width="460" height="100" rx="16" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><rect x="70" y="98" width="200" height="64" rx="12" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="170" y="136" text-anchor="middle" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Session 1</text><text x="290" y="124" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">microVM 1</text><text x="290" y="148" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">own kernel, memory, files</text>
      <rect x="50" y="200" width="460" height="100" rx="16" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><rect x="70" y="218" width="200" height="64" rx="12" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="170" y="256" text-anchor="middle" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Session 2</text><text x="290" y="244" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">microVM 2</text><text x="290" y="268" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">own kernel, memory, files</text>
      <path d="M560 130 H620" stroke="#C4344F" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 5"></path><path d="M560 250 H620" stroke="#C4344F" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 5"></path>
      <rect x="630" y="40" width="450" height="270" rx="20" class="bx" style="fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2"></rect>
      <text x="654" y="80" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Where does a user's state live?</text>
      <text x="654" y="124" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px"><tspan font-weight="700">Lambda:</tspan> vanishes between invocations</text>
      <text x="654" y="164" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px"><tspan font-weight="700">ECS:</tspan> in a container shared by many users;</text>
      <text x="654" y="188" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">another user's request could, in theory, reach it</text>
      <text x="654" y="228" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px"><tspan font-weight="700">Runtime:</tspan> in this user's own sandbox,</text>
      <text x="654" y="252" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">for the whole session, then wiped</text>
      <text x="654" y="290" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">effectively its own dedicated machine</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **The pattern sets the ceiling
diagrams.caption: **The pattern sets the ceiling.** For long jobs the agent tells AgentCore it's busy, not idle, so the session isn't cleaned up mid-task.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 290" aria-label="Runtime time limits by invocation pattern. A synchronous request-response call can take up to 15 minutes, similar to Lambda. A streaming connection, HTTP response streaming or WebSocket, can stay open for up to 60 minutes. An asynchronous job, such as batch processing, multi-agent research or a long document pipeline, can run for up to 8 hours; the agent reports HealthyBusy on its ping endpoint while it works." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <text x="20" y="64" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Synchronous request</text><rect x="300" y="40" width="24" height="40" rx="6" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="338" y="68" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">15 minutes (like Lambda)</text>
      <text x="20" y="144" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Streaming connection</text><rect x="300" y="120" width="98" height="40" rx="6" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="412" y="148" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">60 minutes · HTTP streaming or WebSocket</text>
      <text x="20" y="224" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Asynchronous job</text><rect x="300" y="200" width="780" height="40" rx="6" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="320" y="228" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">8 hours · batch jobs, multi-agent research, long document pipelines</text>
      <text x="300" y="276" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">bars drawn to scale: 15 min · 60 min · 480 min</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **No server code to write
diagrams.caption: **No server code to write.** The SDK provides the web server, the routes and the health check.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 300" aria-label="What BedrockAgentCoreApp adds. Your unchanged Strands agent, with its tools, prompt and model, sits inside. Four lines wrap it: import BedrockAgentCoreApp, create app, decorate the handler with app.entrypoint, and call app.run. The result is an HTTP service on port 8080 with two endpoints: POST /invocations, which passes the JSON payload to your handler, and GET /ping for health checks." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-tool" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-tool" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="20" y="20" width="620" height="260" rx="22" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:3"></rect>
      <text x="44" y="56" class="t ink-proto" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#4B2B97;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">BedrockAgentCoreApp</text><text x="300" y="56" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">HTTP service on port 8080</text>
      <rect x="44" y="76" width="290" height="180" rx="16" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="189" y="118" text-anchor="middle" class="t on-agent" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Your Strands agent</text><text x="189" y="150" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;opacity:.85">tools, prompt, model:</text><text x="189" y="174" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;opacity:.85">unchanged</text>
      <text x="64" y="226" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:14px">def handle(payload): …</text>
      <text x="360" y="104" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">① import BedrockAgentCoreApp</text>
      <text x="360" y="140" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">② app = BedrockAgentCoreApp()</text>
      <text x="360" y="176" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">③ @app.entrypoint</text>
      <text x="360" y="212" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">④ app.run()</text>
      <path d="M644 110 H736" class="ln-data" stroke-width="3" marker-start="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
      <path d="M644 200 H736" class="ln-tool" stroke-width="3" marker-start="url(#ah-tool)" style="stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
      <rect x="740" y="70" width="340" height="80" rx="14" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="760" y="104" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px">POST /invocations</text><text x="760" y="130" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">JSON payload → handle(payload)</text>
      <rect x="740" y="160" width="340" height="80" rx="14" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="760" y="194" class="code" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:#19203F;font-size:16px">GET /ping</text><text x="760" y="220" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">health check: Healthy / HealthyBusy</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **Bring your whole programming model
diagrams.caption: **Bring your whole programming model.** Everything runs inside the microVM; Runtime manages the session around it.

diagrams.title: **Five calls from code to cloud and back
diagrams.caption: **Five calls from code to cloud and back.** The first launch takes a few minutes; later updates are faster because the toolkit reuses cached dependencies.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 300" aria-label="The deployment lifecycle. Configure generates a Dockerfile and the deployment settings. Launch creates the IAM execution role and ECR repository, builds an ARM64 image in CodeBuild, pushes it to ECR and creates the Runtime endpoint. Invoke with the toolkit or boto3; each new session ID gets its own microVM. Stop the session when the conversation is over. Destroy removes the runtime, endpoint, CodeBuild project, role and optionally the ECR repository." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
